subject: Pricing calibration: SMB EU hosted API proposal and model-specific deltas
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Miller <jmiller@apotheo.health>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Hosted API volume proposal — EU SMB package (initial)

Hi Jacob,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the context on your Q4 roadmap. Attached is a compact proposal for an EU-hosted SMB commit that maps to the usage profile you shared (primarily chat + occasional higher-cost LLM calls and embeddings for search). High-level points: 

- Commit structure (12-month):
  • Tier A: 0-500M tokens/month — no commit (pay-as-you-go)
  • Tier B: 500M-2B tokens/month — 10% off base per-token rate with 3-month ramp credit
  • Tier C: 2B+ tokens/month — 18% off base per-token rate (requires 12-mo commit)
- Model differentials: Premium chat models = base * 1.6; Standard chat = base * 1.0; Embeddings = base * 0.35 (embeddings counted per-embed-unit)
- Optional: blended SKU for mixed workloads (we can offer a weighted effective rate if >40% of tokens are embeddings)
- EU data residency + KMS: supported in our EU control plane; we noted your KMS requirement and collected the KMS integration checklist in the attachment.

Attachments: Apotheo_VOL_Proposal_v1.pdf (proposal), redwood_eu_pricing_sheet.xlsx (near-term math).

Next steps I propose:
1) Review the attached, confirm expected monthly token split (chat vs embeddings)
2) If Tier B/C looks right, I can run a blended quote with finance and send a draft SOW/PO-ready DocuSign link

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Diego

Enterprise Sales — EU

From: Jacob Miller <jmiller@apotheo.health>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Hosted API volume proposal — EU SMB package (initial)

Diego — thanks for the fast turnaround and the materials. A few clarifying asks before we loop legal/procurement: 

1) The premium multiplier for "premium chat models" (x1.6) feels high given our usage is mostly short chat turns (~20 tokens avg) and the majority of consumer queries will be embeddings-driven ranking. Can you show a blended example where embeddings are 55% of token-equivalents?
2) Can you confirm whether the embeddings multiplier (0.35) is applied per-embedding or per-token equivalent? We price by embedding call volume on our side so need clarity.
3) We require EU data residency + monthly audit logs for usage and per-token billing detail. Do you support per-route token-level export?

Also — any flexibility on the Tier B breakpoints? Our current pilot will likely land us at ~650-700M tokens/month but with seasonal spikes. A softer ramp (90 days) on true-up would help.

If you can respond with a blended example and a proposed 90-day ramp for Tier B true-up, I can get procurement to start a redline pass.

Appreciate it,
Jacob
Jacob Miller
Head of Data Products
Apotheo Health

Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API volume proposal — EU SMB package (pricing calc & ramp)

Diego / Jacob — pulled the numbers and here's a recommended offer that balances economics and contract simplicity. I attached a cleaned pricing worksheet (redwood_eu_pricing_sheet.xlsx) with examples. Highlights: 

- Definition: embeddings counted per-embedding request; we convert to "token-equivalent" for blended reporting using a simple factor of 32 tokens per embedding call (configurable). We bill embeddings as a separate unit on the invoice but will show an "effective token rate" for comparison.

- Proposed committed schedule (12-mo standard):
  • Tier B (recommended for Apotheo): commit 600M tokens/month (12-mo) — effective discount 14% off base rate during ramp, true-up applied quarterly.
  • 90-day soft ramp: first 90 days billed at 70% of committed level; overage treated as PAYG at standard rate; true-up after 90 days (quarterly).
  • Tier C eligibility at contract amendment if sustained >2B tokens/mo for 2 consecutive quarters.

- Model premium adjustments:
  • Premium chat: +45% (we recommend reducing from 60% to 45% given short-turn usage)
  • Embeddings: 0.30x (lowered to help your use case)
  • Result: blended effective rate example (assuming 55% embeddings by call volume and our 32-token conversion): effective per-token rate ~0.0000128 EUR (see sheet for calc).

- Conditions: 12-mo minimum, quarterly usage true-up, EU data residency + monthly audit export (CSV) included. KMS integration: standard SOW item, we estimated 10 business days for setup.

I'll attach the pricing sheet and a sample SOW template. If this looks good, I suggest:
1) Diego to get verbal approval from Jacob on the 45% premium / 0.30x embeddings and the 90-day ramp
2) We generate a DocuSign PO/SOW and set signature deadlines (we can include a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to 2 weeks of expected usage if they sign before end of month)

Laura Bennett
